content.text: {"title":"AERO9500 Preliminary Report (Part 1)","overview":"Design a new space mission benefiting Australia and identify main elements of its space segment. Demonstrate understanding of space segment systems (launch, orbits etc.) by developing a preliminary plan for the mission. Part 1 is a planning report to guide Part 2 main assignment.","deliverables":["Preliminary report (single PDF) presenting mission plan and preliminary technical work"],"format":{"length":"Ideally 2-3 pages","structure":"Mission concept and rationale (what it does, users, need); Project plan including Gantt chart or timetable and sources of information; Preliminary progress with technical content","other":"Use software of choice (STK, PIGI, flightclub/other with approval) supplemented with hand calculations as needed"},"requirements":[{"id":"R1","text":"Mission must benefit Australia; keep concept simple - suggested ideas: bushfire tracking and alert system, weather satellite, internet/communication, earth observation for city planning/real estate."},{"id":"R2","text":"Present mission concept and its rationale including what it will do, who are the users, why it is needed."},{"id":"R3","text":"Present project plan for how to complete the full assignment, including either a Gantt chart or a timetable."},{"id":"R4","text":"List sources of information planned to use for design."},{"id":"R5","text":"Decide and state which software package will be used to complete the design: STK, PIGI (requires registration for license via competition), or other software (e.g., flightclub) after discussion with instructor."},{"id":"R6","text":"Provide preliminary progress with technical content and evidence of sufficient work done to date showing understanding of space segment systems (launch, orbits etc.)."},{"id":"R7","text":"Supplement software design with hand calculations as needed."}]}
